reflections.title: A Monastic Reading List
reflections.author: Prior Daniel Manger, OSB Cam.
reflections.excerpt: Companions for a deeper contemplative life.
paragraphs: Prior Daniel recommends these books for exploring monastic spirituality today.
readingList: Perspectives on the Rule of St. Benedict — Liturgical Press
From the Tools of Good Works to the Heart of Humility — Aquinata Böckmann
Hildegard of Bingen: Solutions to Thirty-Eight Questions — Liturgical Press
Saint Bernard’s Three-Course Banquet — Bernard Bonowitz
The Historical Atlas of Eastern and Western Christian Monasticism — Juan María Laboa
The Privilege of Love — Peter-Damian Belisle
How to Inhabit Time — James K. A. Smith
The Practice of Spiritual Direction — William A. Barry and William J. Connolly
The Tears of Things: Prophetic Wisdom for an Age of Outrage — Richard Rohr
My Battle Against Hitler — Dietrich von Hildebrand
